summary: Jon Harris, 59, of Derry, New Hampshire, collapsed and died Wednesday evening while hiking with his 15-year-old son near Maroon Lake (10,000 ft) outside Aspen; two bystanders began CPR before Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers and medics arrived but he could not be revived; cause pending autopsy/toxicology.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Run 817 (Colorado Public Radio news archive). Date pinned: CPR article published 2015-08-06 reports he 'died Wednesday evening' -> 2015-08-05 (Wednesday-verified).
